title: Hanz Grundown first meeting

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Hey, you there! I need your help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, you there! I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You're the new Thaddeus, right? I'm the Night Manager of the Grundown Ritz. Grundown. Hanz to my friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the new Thaddeus, right? I'm the Night Manager of the Grundown Ritz. Grundown. Hanz to my friends.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Right. Thaddeus would offer a discount to some of our more prestigious guests.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Thaddeus would offer a discount to some of our more prestigious guests.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: My guests have varied tastes. Sometimes they wonder out in this direction instead of heading to the casinos and clubs in Midtown.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My guests have varied tastes. Sometimes they wonder out in this direction instead of heading to the casinos and clubs in Midtown.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I have to keep some very wealthy and important people very happy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to keep some very wealthy and important people very happy.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Look, the Grundown Ritz is a fine hotel. Too nice for this area, but that's hyper-gentrification for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, the Grundown Ritz is a fine hotel. Too nice for this area, but that's hyper-gentrification for you.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Your business is four hundred and seventy-five metres away. You're in my sphere of influence. That means I can... influence your bottom line.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your business is four hundred and seventy-five metres away. You're in my sphere of influence. That means I can... influence your bottom line.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Sometimes they want to slum it downtown with some greasy noodles, a green soda and some poverty safari.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes they want to slum it downtown with some greasy noodles, a green soda and some poverty safari.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: One week your street is paved with diamonds, the next it's a river of shit. Or vice versa. That's just Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One week your street is paved with diamonds, the next it's a river of shit. Or vice versa. That's just Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Anything within five hundred meters of the Grundown Ritz is still my responsibility, at least as far as those guests are concerned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything within five hundred meters of the Grundown Ritz is still my responsibility, at least as far as those guests are concerned.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you sure your guests are also mine?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure your guests are also mine?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you sure your guests are also mine?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you sure your guests are also mine?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's this got to do with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's this got to do with me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's this got to do with me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's this got to do with me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I get your point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I get your point.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I get your point.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I get your point.
